description:
Uma ukuphepha komndeni wakho kuyinto eza kuqala, khona-ke uhlelo lokusebenza lokulawula abazali lwe-Findmykids kanye ne-GPS family tracker lungolwakho!

I-Findmykids inikeza ukulawula kwabazali, ukuthola usizo lwefoni yami, kanye nokulandelela indawo enembile ku-tracker eyodwa yendawo yefoni ye-GPS kanye nohlelo lokusebenza lokulandelela i-GPS.

Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uvela ku-Family Link, uhlelo lokusebenza lokulawula abazali lwe-Qustodio noma uhlelo lokusebenza lwezingane lwe-Qustodio, noma ubuke i-Airdroid parent control, uzozizwa usekhaya nge-geolocator yethu ecacile eyakhelwe abazali: kulula ukuqala, usuku nosuku oluthembekile, futhi ihlonipha ubumfihlo bomndeni wakho.

Abazali abazame i-iSharing gps location tracker, i-Geozilla family gps locator, noma i-X gps tracker bavame ukuthi i-Findmykids kulula ukuqala futhi kulula ukuyithemba. Igxila kulokho okubalulekile: ukukusiza uqonde ukuthi ingane yakho ikuphi, ukuthi ihamba kanjani usuku lonke, nokuthi ingadinga nini ukunakwa kwakho. Ngezixwayiso ezicatshangelwe kahle namathuluzi asekela imikhuba yansuku zonke, uhlala unolwazi ngaphandle kokuzizwa ukhungathekile.

Iphinde ihambisane kahle nefoni yengane; Uma uke wasebenzisa i-Setracker2 noma uhlelo lokusebenza lokubuka lwe-Setracker2 ngaphambili, ukuqhubekela phambili kulula. Uma ufuna uhlelo lokusebenza olulula lokulandelela indawo olugxile ekucaciseni kanye nemiphumela, usesendaweni efanele. Lusethe kanye bese uthembela kuzibuyekezo ezihambisanayo ezikusiza ukuthi wenze izinqumo ezifanele ngokushesha.

Izici ezibalulekile abazali abazibhekayo:
• Ukulandelela indawo ebukhoma yengane kanye nomzila — Buka isikhundla samanje sengane yakho ngesikhathi sangempela bese ubuyekeza umzila nezindawo ezivakashelwe emini.

• Ukulawula kwabazali — Bona ukuthi ingane yakho ichitha isikhathi esingakanani kuzinhlelo zokusebenza esikoleni bese ugcina isikhathi sesikrini silinganisela.
• Lalela umsindo bukhoma — Lalela okwenzekayo eduze kwengane yakho uma udinga ukuqiniseka ukuthi iphephile.
• Dlula imodi yokuthula — Thumela Isignali Ephakeme ekhala noma ifoni ithule noma isesikhwameni.
• Izexwayiso zokunyakaza — Engeza izindawo ezifana nesikole, ikhaya, noma ipaki bese waziswa lapho ingane yakho ifika noma ihamba.

• Isignali ye-SOS efonini yengane — Ingane yakho ingathinta inkinobho ye-SOS ukuze ikwazise ngokushesha esimweni esiphuthumayo.

Uma ingane yakho ihamba iya ekilasini, ihlala isikhathi eside ekuzijwayezeni, noma ithatha indlela entsha eya endlini yomngane, ungangena ngokuthula, ngaphandle kokuyishayela ucingo noma ukuyiphazamisa. Uma ifoni ivuliwe, i-Loud Signal ikusiza ukuthi uyifinyelele. Uma ikudinga ngokushesha, inkinobho ye-SOS ikutshela ukuthi ikuphi nokuthi ifuna usizo manje. Ukuqonda indawo kanye nezaziso zokufika kukwazisa ukuthi inqubo isendleleni, ukuze uchithe isikhathi esincane ukhathazekile.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lokulawula abazali lwe-Findmykids lwakhelwe imindeni enezinhlelo namadivayisi ahlukene. Engeza izindawo ezibalulekile kanye bese uhlelo lokusebenza luhlala lubuka buthule, lukwazisa lapho ingane yakho ifika noma ihamba. Lusebenzise ngesikhathi sokuhamba, amahora esikole, izinsuku zokudlala, kanye nohambo. Uthola umongo wokwenza ngokuzethemba, konke endaweni eyodwa. Futhi uma uhlola ezinye izindlela zokusetha indawo ye-gps kanye nefoni, noma ufuna i-GPS locator ethembekile elula ukuyiqonda, i-Findmykids ibeka ukucaca kuqala.

Sisebenza ngokuqhubekayo ukuze sithuthukise ulwazi: izibuyekezo ezisheshayo, amamephu acacile, kanye nezaziso ezithembekile. Uma ukhetha isitayela esijwayelekile esisetshenziswa yi-GPS kids tracker noma uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-geo tracker olujwayelekile, uzothola isikhombimsebenzisi sinembile kusukela ngosuku lokuqala. Isiqondiso esicatshangelwe ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza sikusiza ukuthi usethe konke ngemizuzu, ngamathiphu akwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngokufinyelela nomzali noma umnakekeli uma lokho kusiza inqubo yakho.

Uhlelo lwethu lokusebenza lucela izimvume ezilandelayo:
– ukufinyelela ikhamera nezithombe – ukufaka isithombe sengane;
– ukufinyelela kumakrofoni – ukuthumela imilayezo yezwi engxoxweni;
– izinsizakalo zokufinyelela – ukukhawulela isikhathi esikrinini se-smartphone.

Uma uhlangabezana nanoma yiziphi izinkinga zobuchwepheshe usebenzisa i-Findmykids, ungahlala ufinyelela ukwesekwa okungu-24/7 ngengxoxo yohlelo lokusebenza noma nge-imeyili ku-support@findmykids.org.

Ungazijwayeza ngamadokhumenti ethu:
- Isivumelwano Somsebenzisi - https://findmykids.org/docs/terms-of-use/ios/en
- Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo - https://findmykids.org/docs/privacy-policy/ios/en
summary: Uhlelo lokusebenza lokulandelela indawo ye-GPS kanye nokulawula kwabazali. Landelela futhi uthole indawo yomndeni wami
